purpose: remove concurrency-dependent trace-duration and AIMD-window confounding from S2
pressure_exposure_contract: identical 90-second arrival cutoff and exactly three 30-second controller opportunities for every cell; completion drains after 90 seconds without further control, and pressure fraction is reported rather than forced equal because concurrency is the treatment axis
evidence_boundary: SGLSim metadata DES preliminary fixed-arrival sensitivity; not physical A100 evidence. Failure-rate aggregation uses the common 90-second exposure and the parent protocol's sparse-rate first-order Poisson mixture.
